messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped, boundary-aware iOS subagent definition with strong routing cues and constraints, slightly padded by repetitive guidance.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly states triggers (Swift/SwiftUI iOS features, UI, data layer) and the specialty, so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, constraints (Swift 6 strict concurrency, @Observable, MVVM/TCA), workflow, and a quality checklist are explicit, though there is no explicit output/deliverable contract.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A dedicated 边界与交接 section precisely lists out-of-scope work (server, Android, cross-platform, system architecture, build/CI/signing) and hand-back conditions.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is well-structured but somewhat long, with the core principles partly restated in the best-practices and checklist sections, adding redundancy.

suggestions: In the best-practices and checklist sections, remove or merge repeated statements of the core principles so each principle is stated only once, eliminating the redundancy flagged by the Conciseness review.
Replace checklist entries that repeat core-principle explanations with brief cross-references to the relevant core principle, keeping only actionable verification steps in the checklist.
